notes.title: Update 1.2.0 is Live!
notes.content:
A new year, a new major update to Ghostlight Manor!

Challenging [b]AI opponents[/b] await you in multiplayer, allowing you to test your competitive skills whenever you want! New and returning players are encouraged to play the [b]revamped multiplayer tutorial[/b] which covers everything you’ll need to know to be a monster hunting pro. Also new in multiplayer is a toggleable [b]split-screen view[/b] which will allow you to keep track of your opponents’ actions more clearly. What more do you need to need to know? Those [b]new multiplayer achievements[/b] won’t achieve themselves!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27117093/6332b4f8b8fdc45e5bfe015fee9f8fe054e8ab1b.png[/img]

Included in this update:
[list]
[*] [b]14 new Achievements[/b] to add to your collection.
[*] [b]Updated gamepad support[/b] makes playing Ghostlight Manor and navigating menus a breeze.
[*] [b]Multiplayer AI opponents[/b] are always ready to challenge you, even if your friends are not.
[*] [b]Split-screen multiplayer[/b] gives the mode a new tactical look and feel.
[*] [b]The revamped multiplayer tutorial[/b] will be a helpful refresher for old players and essential learning for new players.
[*] [b]New “stars” system[/b] in multiplayer will unlock future content, so start stocking up!
[*] [b]Easter eggs[/b] are scattered around the world of Ghostlight; pressing [i]“Shift + E”[/i] will reveal them to you!
[*] [b]General UI improvements[/b] include: tooltips, UX feedback, and art updates.
[*] [b]Various bug fixes[/b]
[/list]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27117093/ed34348e4b6bb00939e2085de4d61830362d99ae.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27117093/892a5b450560cf540e7825ffe347fa965fc1af8d.png[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27117093/17561c952969ac68d71f819e85906951382b5a46.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27117093/1826afeca297258bd5313157c073a96faaa28906.png[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27117093/c5ef47c980bafb0e6ede70336f9e19d49d1c83c9.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27117093/29b2547b135d306255aa30b901483433d374b60a.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Ghostlight Manor Update v1.1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[b]Story Mode[/b]
[list]
    [*]Ghost Flusters (Level 43): Fixed a bug where destroying Ghostly Demolition crystals with ‘Limited Beams’ active would prevent level completion.
    [*]Updated Drac voiceover at the beginning of tutorial levels.
    [*]Locked beams in the beam inventory will display a tooltip with the number of Troll Tokens needed for unlocking.
[/list]
[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
    [*]Improvements to joining and inviting friends to multiplayer lobbies and matches in progress.
    [*]Non-lobby leaders may now invite players from their Steam friends list.
    [*]New popups for failing to join a lobby. (More to come!)
    [*]Fixed a bug where the ‘Private Lobby’ icon would not appear for non-lobby leaders.
    [*]Fixed a bug where joining or inviting to a lobby would produce a ‘Null’ player slot name.
    [*]Fixed a bug where invited players would get stuck in the multiplayer intro sequence if they had not completed the tutorial region.
    [*]Forest Grump: Split goal into two objectives to track opponent progress more easily. 20,000 / 40,000 point checkpoints.
    [*]Temple of Tomb: Split goal into three objectives to track opponent progress more easily. 40,000 / 80,000 / 100,000 point checkpoints.
    [*]Fixed Ruby Gargoyles not spawning on 5-star Cat rescues.
[/list]
[b]Misc.[/b]
[list]
    [*]Steam collectibles updated: badges, trading cards, backgrounds, and emoticons!
[/list]

notes.title: Ghostlight Manor Update v1.1
notes.content:
Ghostlight Manor Multiplayer has arrived, along with an expansion to the single player campaign! Participate in the Lightbot Tryouts and test your monster-hunting skills against the toughest competitors in town. This release includes a host of spooky and challenging updates:

[b]A brand-new competitive cross-platform multiplayer mode for 2-4 players[/b] (LAN or online play) where you race to complete objectives and sabotage other players with combo attacks.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27117093/36947efcc747c498bffa54a6f12fda0ba9f599a6.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27117093/17b8c0ef76302150e6ba12304653fb6f08ec19f5.png[/img]

[b]Two new characters in story mode[/b]: the tanky, troublesome Gargoyle and the friendly, time-bending Witch! The Gargoyle is tough to scare and shields other monsters from the Laser Beam, while the Witch uses time magic to freeze the advancing creatures so you have more time to plan and act!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27117093/d3e57db30bc507d97657206b22955eca20fb345c.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27117093/dace6227857adccb3f9ac5e86c0067096581822c.png[/img]

[b]Three new special light beams and custom loadouts for Lightbot![/b] The Spotlight Beam targets a single creature anywhere on the board, the Bubble Beam puts a creature into a protective stasis, and the X-Ray Beam can see through unrevealed creatures.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27117093/f6e4f20c8b922ac49c5dd4217dda90be0946efdf.png[/img]

Also included are loads of additional content:
[list]
[*][b]A new practice mode [/b]allows you to play an endless level to experiment with different strategies.
[*][b]10 new achievements and Steam collectibles [/b]for all you completionists out there.
[*][b]Revamped tutorials [/b]to make learning a breeze.
[*][b]New and improved end game cinematic [/b]to further explore the Ghostlight Manor universe.
[*][b]Updated background art and new music and VO [/b]for spookier gameplay.
[*][b]Controller support[/b] for Xbox and joystick controllers, as well as updated keyboard inputs.
[*][b]Steam Cloud integration [/b]to save Ghostlight Manor across platforms.
[*][b]Numerous gameplay and UI improvements[/b]… as well as minor text and bug fixes! Woohoo!
[/list]
